graph.title: Introduction to Natural Numbers
graph.subject: Mathematics
graph.description: Learn what natural numbers are, how to count and arrange them in order. Includes simple examples from daily life in Wayanad.

graph.title: Our Environment - Forests and Plants
graph.subject: Environmental Science
graph.description: Study the importance of forests, types of plants found in Wayanad and the relationship between humans and nature.

graph.title: Malayalam Alphabets - Vowels
graph.subject: Malayalam
graph.description: Practice writing and reading Malayalam vowels (swarangal). Worksheets available for download. Swarangal padikam.

graph.title: Simple Addition and Subtraction
graph.subject: Mathematics
graph.description: Practice adding and subtracting two-digit numbers using the column method. Exercises included with answers.

graph.title: Our Body - Organs and Their Functions
graph.subject: Science
graph.description: Learn about the major organs of the human body - heart, lungs, stomach - and what they do to keep us healthy.

graph.title: Water Conservation and Rain
graph.subject: Environmental Science
graph.description: Understand the water cycle, importance of rain, and how tribal communities in Wayanad conserve water traditionally.

graph.title: Math Quiz - Natural Numbers
graph.subject: Mathematics
graph.description: Test your understanding of natural numbers, ordering and basic counting.

graph.title: EVS Quiz - Forests and Plants
graph.subject: Environmental Science
graph.description: Answer questions about forests, plants and environmental conservation based on Lesson 002.

graph.title: Malayalam Vowels Practice
graph.subject: Malayalam
graph.description: Identify and match Malayalam vowels in this short quiz.

graph.title: Science Quiz - Human Body
graph.subject: Science
graph.description: Questions on major body organs, their names and basic functions.

graph.title: ST Pre-Matric Scholarship
graph.description: Central government scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students studying in Class 1 to 10. Covers tuition, hostel and book allowances.

graph.title: Kerala Tribal Welfare Scholarship
graph.description: State government scholarship for tribal students in Kerala. Apply through the ITDP office or tribal welfare portal.

graph.title: Basic Computer Skills for Beginners
graph.description: Free 10-hour online course covering basic computer operations, the internet and typing. Available in Malayalam.

graph.title: Spoken English for Rural Learners
graph.description: A beginner-friendly spoken English course designed for students in rural and tribal areas. Audio-based learning included.
